title: Angry Customer Demanding Refund

customer_profile.name: Alex Rivera
customer_profile.opening_message: I bought a laptop from you guys 45 days ago and it's already broken! The screen just went black. I want my money back RIGHT NOW. This is absolutely ridiculous!
customer_profile.secret_condition: Will accept warranty repair if agent shows genuine empathy AND offers expedited service

checkpoints.description: Acknowledge the customer's frustration before anything else
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Acknowledge the customer's frustration before anything else

checkpoints.description: Express empathy for the situation (broken laptop is genuinely frustrating)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Express empathy for the situation (broken laptop is genuinely frustrating)

checkpoints.description: Verify the purchase date and explain the 30-day return window
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Verify the purchase date and explain the 30-day return window

checkpoints.description: Pivot to the warranty option as an alternative solution
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Pivot to the warranty option as an alternative solution

checkpoints.description: Offer to expedite the repair process
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Offer to expedite the repair process

checkpoints.description: If customer remains upset, offer escalation to supervisor or partial store credit
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: If customer remains upset, offer escalation to supervisor or partial store credit

common_mistakes_to_watch: Immediately saying 'no' to the refund without empathy
Arguing with the customer about the policy
Getting defensive when customer is hostile

scenario_context: Customer purchased a laptop 45 days ago. Return policy is 30 days. Warranty covers repairs for 1 year. Customer has been a member for 3 years with 12 previous purchases.
